wiki.title: Mary Gardner Belk
wiki.extract: Mary Gardner Belk (born October 5, 1956 ) is a Democratic member of the North Carolina General Assembly representing the state's 88th House district, which includes portions of Southeast Mecklenburg County. 2017 was her first year in North Carolina House. In the 2017–2018 session, Belk served on the Transportation, Banking, and Justice and Public Safety Appropriations Committees. She's a member of the Progressive House Caucus.
